name: Restrofood Lite – Online Food Ordering, Menu, Delivery, and Restaurant Management Plugin
author: themelooks

sections.description:
RestroFood is an all-in-one Restaurant Management Plugin for WordPress and WooCommerce that helps food businesses manage online menus, WooCommerce food ordering, delivery, and takeaway, online and offline POS management, multi-branch control, multi-delivery fees, automatic invoice printing, in-restaurant ordering, tips management, and a table reservation system from a single powerful dashboard. Built for restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, and online food delivery businesses.

🎥 Watch RestroFood WordPress Restaurant Plugin Overview

Explore All The Powerful WordPress Online Restaurant Management Features From RestroFood 👇

🔗Live Demo | 🔗Documentation | 🔗Features | 🔗Video Tutorials | 🔗Restaurant Free Theme | 🔗Upgrade To Pro

Need help setting up your online food ordering and restaurant management website? Contact Us

Who Can Benefit from RestroFood WordPress Restaurant Plugin?

Restaurants, cafés, bakeries, cloud kitchens, and all types of food businesses benefit from the RestroFood WordPress restaurant plugin. Because of this, all-in-one WooCommerce restaurant management system streamlines online food ordering, delivery & takeaway, table reservations, POS management, and multi-branch operations. RestroFood makes restaurant management simple, fast, and efficient.

➤ Quick Service / Casual Dining / Fine Dining Restaurant

Challenges We Solve – Complete WordPress Restaurant Management & Online Ordering Solution 💪

Running a restaurant or food delivery business comes with many operational challenges. RestroFood WordPress restaurant plugin is trusted by 1000+ food businesses to solve these problems with a complete WooCommerce restaurant management Solution.

➤ Problem: Managing online food orders manually is slow, error-prone, and hard to track.

Solve: RestroFood automates online food orders with real-time notifications, order tracking, and WooCommerce integration, making order management fast, accurate, and hassle-free.

➤ Problem: Multi-branch operations make menu updates, delivery, and orders complicated.

Solve: Our multi-branch restaurant management system allows branch-specific menus, delivery zones, pickup times, custom fees, and independent dashboards for each branch.

➤ Problem: In-restaurant order management is chaotic, leading to mistakes and slow service.

Solve: RestroFood streamlines in-restaurant order management with table-based ordering, real-time order tracking, and support for single or multi-branch restaurants, reducing errors and speeding up service.

➤ Problem: Table reservations lead to overbooking or no-shows.

Solve: RestroFood prevents overbooking and no-shows with a smart table reservation system featuring time slots, branch-based scheduling, automated email notifications, and real-time reservation management.

➤ Problem: Delivery and pickup logistics are hard to manage across locations.

Solve: RestroFood simplifies delivery and pickup management with automated distance-based fees, time slots, and branch-specific delivery rules.

➤ Problem: Point of Sale operations require manual tracking and multiple systems.

Solve: RestroFood WooCommerce POS system manages in-store sales with multiple counters, online/offline mode, barcode scanning, and instant invoicing.

➤ Problem: Checkout issues can cause abandoned carts or missed tips.

Solve: RestroFood reduces cart abandonment with same-page checkout, floating cart, order scheduling, and flexible tip options.

➤ Problem: Managing menus and product offerings can be difficult and may look unprofessional without proper tools.

Solve: RestroFood WooCommerce restaurant menu plugin helps create professional menus with layouts, extras, nutrition info, and full theme compatibility.

➤ Problem: Manual invoice printing slows down restaurant operations and increases errors.

Solve: RestroFood automates invoice printing with PrintNode support, multi-printer connectivity, and error-free order receipts.

➤ Problem: Lack of analytics makes decision-making difficult.

Solve: RestroFood provides real-time order analytics, sales reports, and a centralized restaurant dashboard for data-driven decisions.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
The easy way.

Go to your WordPress Dashboard. Navigate to Plugins > Add New and then search for “Restrofood Lite”. Click on Install and then Activate the Plugin.

That’s it, Restrofood Lite Plugin is now activated on your site!

The hard way..

Download “Restrofood Lite WordPress Plugin” and then extract the zip file and just drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation and then activate the Plugin from Plugins page.
sections.faq:
What is required to use the RestroFood plugin?

You need a WordPress website with WooCommerce installed and a hosting account to start using RestroFood.

Does RestroFood support the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions?

Yes, RestroFood is fully compatible with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce versions.

Will RestroFood work with my theme and page builder?

Yes, RestroFood works with all WooCommerce-compatible themes and popular page builders.

Does RestroFood work with Wix or Squarespace?

No, RestroFood works only with WordPress and WooCommerce.

Can RestroFood handle online food ordering with WooCommerce?

Yes, RestroFood provides a complete WooCommerce online food ordering system with delivery, pickup, pre-orders, and scheduled orders.

How does RestroFood manage food delivery?

RestroFood manages delivery with time slots, location-based availability, order tracking, and flexible delivery or pickup options.

Does RestroFood include a WooCommerce POS system?

Yes, RestroFood includes a powerful WooCommerce POS system with online/offline support and multiple counters.

Can I manage multiple restaurant locations with RestroFood?

Yes, RestroFood supports multi-branch restaurant management from a single dashboard.

Does RestroFood support distance-based delivery fees?

Yes, you can set distance-based, zip-code-based, or zone-based delivery fees easily.

Can RestroFood print order invoices automatically?

Yes, RestroFood supports automatic invoice printing with thermal receipt printers and PrintNode integration.

Can customers book tables online with RestroFood?

Yes, RestroFood offers an online table reservation system with real-time availability.

Can customers order from their table using RestroFood?

Yes, RestroFood supports in-restaurant table ordering with real-time order tracking.

Can customers add tips at checkout?

Yes, RestroFood includes a free tip management system at checkout.

Which payment gateways does RestroFood support?

RestroFood supports all WooCommerce payment gateways.

Does RestroFood provide shortcodes?

Yes, RestroFood offers shortcodes like [RestroFood_products] for easy customization.

Can I install RestroFood on client websites?

Yes, RestroFood can be installed on client websites, ideal for developers and agencies.

Do you offer refunds?

Yes, refunds are available according to the RestroFood refund policy.

Does RestroFood have a free version?

Yes, RestroFood Lite is free and includes essential online food ordering features.

Is there a premium or advanced version of RestroFood available?

Yes. Along with the free version, RestroFood offers a pro version & premium add-ons for advanced features like POS, multibranch management, delivery fees, and more
